verdict.rationale: Mangopay is API-first. The docs invite users to explore 'all Mangopay's features' through the Sandbox API, and it publishes an OpenAPI spec plus official SDKs in six languages. Webhooks are documented as API objects, and Dashboard setup is presented as just one option ('If using the Dashboard'), which implies parity for that feature. There is no explicit statement that Dashboard and API capabilities match one-to-one, and some flows are UI-driven, such as accepting or refusing test payins via a click-through and the mandated hosted KYC/KYB flow. Missing for 10: an explicit API/Dashboard parity statement, an API alternative for sandbox payin acceptance and hosted verification steps, and independent hands-on corroboration.
